description: This PHP script handles displaying related lists for the Invoice module in vtiger CRM. It manages redirection for single page layout, retrieves entity info, assigns variables to Smarty templates, and manages related list sessions.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: CRMEntity class provides methods for CRUD operations on CRM entities, including retrieving entity info.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: vtigerCRM_Smarty is a class extending Smarty template engine, used for rendering templates in vtiger CRM.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: RelatedListViewSession manages session state for related list views, including adding and retrieving related modules.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab category for the current module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related lists for a given module and focus object.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks if a particular field has permission within a module.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence field for a module if any.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Retrieves update information for a given record.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks availability and status of specific UI buttons.
